limitations: Historical source records and annual country values have different units and coverage. They are not a causal model or a live risk forecast.
A mapped coordinate retains the provider's geographic precision. It is not proof of an exact incident location or current territorial control.
Provider geographic labels are retained as data classifications; this software makes no independent determination of borders or sovereignty.
The downloaded selection is bounded to 200 records and 1 MiB. Its matched and omitted counts remain explicit; full source partitions are separate files.
Historical coded observations, 2011–2025; not a current operational feed.
A selected-country subset, not complete violence, news or policy coverage.
Provider country labels and coordinates are retained; lookup codes do not assert political boundaries or legal status.
The provider Israel category contains location records in Gaza and the West Bank; no separate country series is invented.
A coordinate can represent an administrative area, broad feature, country or estimated sea/air location; inspect where_prec.
Date windows and date_prec are preserved; midnight strings in the raw source are not precise event timestamps.
Low, best and high are provider estimates, not confidence intervals. Aggregate reporting can yield nonordered estimates; values are not repaired.
Clear is the provider coding status, not a human review or a guarantee of truth.
Source references are bibliographic metadata. Original news articles and private evidence are not bundled.
Some whole records are omitted by publication scope; absence is not evidence of no violence.
Annual economy-level context; not local conditions or conflict-event evidence.
Nulls and unreturned periods are separate coverage gaps, never zero, interpolation or carried-forward values.
Values can be model estimates. Blank provider status is unknown; explicitly flagged forecasts and unrecognized flags are withheld.
Each series has its own units, denominator, coverage and source methodology; no regional totals or causal links are computed.
Same country/year alignment with conflict events is descriptive and does not identify a causal relationship.
